_description: Versioned evaluation protocol for Andromeda SWE-bench runs. This file must be present and its SHA-256 must be recorded in the run manifest before any model request is dispatched. A run without a matching protocol hash is not a valid capability evaluation.

exposure_registry.semantics: Any instance that has appeared in a prediction file, run bundle, debug session, or manual inspection is permanently excluded from capability evaluation. Once excluded, an instance can never become held-out evidence.
exposure_registry.registry_format: JSONL, one row per excluded instance. Required fields: instance_id, first_seen_run_id, reason, first_seen_commit, first_seen_at.
exposure_registry.enforcement: The 'no-excluded-tasks' preflight check in BenchmarkLauncher must pass before any image pull or model call. Scored runs without an exclusion registry path are blocked at launch.
exposure_registry.update_policy: After every run, all selected instance_ids must be appended to the registry before the run bundle is finalized.

label_access.who_has_labels: The official SWE-bench evaluator (run post-hoc). No person or process with access to the agent or prompt may inspect labels before the run completes.
label_access.label_source: princeton-nlp/SWE-bench (or successor benchmark). Labels are determined by the official evaluator container, not by any internal test runner.
label_access.oracle_prohibition: Scored runs must use evalMode='scored_strict'. The preflight check rejects SWEBENCH_SEARCH=1 and any other oracle-mode flag.

selection_procedure.sampling: Instances are drawn uniformly at random from the benchmark dataset, filtered against the exclusion registry. The random seed must be recorded in the run manifest.
selection_procedure.stratification: No stratification by repository, difficulty, or any other attribute that could bias the sample toward known-solvable instances.
selection_procedure.freeze_before_generation: The complete selected instance ID list must be written to the task list file and its SHA-256 recorded in the run manifest before the first model request.

frozen_configuration_fields.freeze_semantics: All fields must be set before the first model request. Any change to these fields after the run starts invalidates the run as a capability evaluation.

official_scoring_command.note: The evaluator must be run on the same JSONL file that was produced by the runner. The JSONL must not be modified after the run completes.

primary_metric.name: end_to_end_resolution_rate
primary_metric.denominator: All selected instances, including exact-apply failures, infra failures, and timeouts.

required_artifacts: evaluation_card.md (human-readable summary with all required fields)

launch_gate.description: The run launcher must verify this protocol file exists and record its SHA-256 in the run manifest before dispatching any workers. If the protocol file is absent or its hash does not match the manifest, the run is blocked.
